models_evaluated: general-purpose LLMs (2 models, not named in abstract)

links.outcome: LLM accuracy on orthopaedic benchmark questions under correct and incorrect user hints
links.effect: Baseline accuracy 78%; correct hints 71% (p = 0.49); incorrect hints 48% (p < 0.001), sycophancy error rate 52%.
links.quote: With incorrect hints, LLM accuracy declined significantly (48%) (p < 0.001), with a sycophancy error rate of 52%.

links.outcome: Whether LLMs contradict or propagate false information placed in user prompts
links.effect: Models perpetuated incorrect attributions 99% of the time yet corrected statistical distortions 97% of the time.
links.quote: In noncontradiction tasks, models perpetuated incorrect attributions 99% of the time yet reliably corrected statistical distortions 97% of the time.

screen.reason: Evaluates sycophantic behavior and vulnerability to user cues in LLMs on orthopaedic benchmarks without testing a specific deployment guardrail or practice.
